$comment: Bazantic x402/MPP Gateway config. Wraps Finch's HTTP API (bot/src/http.ts). The gateway is the METERED path; the same endpoint is also callable directly (Finch is a peer, not a gatekeeper). Register at bazantic.* with BAZANTIC_API_KEY, then set the deployed BASE_URL below.

service.name: finch
service.title: Finch — Robinhood Chain wallet provenance & Pons launch data
service.description: Factual, read-only answers about where a Robinhood Chain (EVM 4663) wallet's tokens came from and about Pons launchpad activity. Backed by a Substreams pipeline (thegraph.market endpoint) sunk to Postgres. No trading, scoring, or recommendations.

upstream.$comment: forwarded if a direct caller sets them; the Bazantic gateway does not populate them, so gateway calls reach Finch with no agent identity — /calls logs them as an opaque per-request trace id only

pricing.$comment: LIVE: 1 MCENT/call. Set in the Bazantic dashboard Resources panel (baz CLI has no pricing subcommand) then PUBLISH. Amount 0 = free/no-402; a nonzero amount engages the x402 challenge. Settles USDC on Base (eip155:8453). A bare /query is a no-op probe (200); a real param gets the 402.
